# Benchmark point estimates

```{r benchmark_pestimate, echo=FALSE}
results = NULL
n = 99
#n = 5
pb = txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = n, style = 3)
for(i in 0:n){
  attempt <- tryCatch({
    # Load data and gt tree
    ## load, clean, write, read each nexus file
    ### Data first
    raw <- readLines(paste("simulations_data/simulated_traditions_22_07/sequences_", i, ".nex", sep = ""), warn = FALSE)
    # create the dates vector for bayesian methods
    matches <- regmatches(raw, regexec("ms_([0-9]+)\\|([0-9]+)", raw))
    matched_matrix <- do.call(rbind, lapply(matches, function(x) if(length(x) == 3) x[2:3] else NULL))
    # Create a lookup vector: c("305" = 246, "108" = 120, ...)
    dates_vector <- setNames(as.numeric(matched_matrix[,2]), matched_matrix[,1])
    # and now clean the names to avoid issues with nexus reading
    clean_raw <- gsub("ms\\_|[|]\\S*", "", raw)
    tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".nex")
    writeLines(clean_raw, tmp)
    data <- ape::read.nexus.data(tmp)
    unlink(tmp)
    data = phyDat(data, type = "USER", levels = 0:10, ambiguity=NA)
    ### Then GT, without forgetting the 0-length edge conversion
    gt_raw = readLines(con = paste("simulations_data/simulated_traditions_22_07/tree_", i, ".newick", sep = ""), warn = FALSE)
    gt <- convert_gt_internal_nodes(gt_raw)
  }, error = function(e) {
    # Print a warning showing which file failed
    message(sprintf("Skipping iteration %d due to error: %s", i, e$message))
    return(NULL)
  })
  
  # --- 2. Skip to next iteration if loading failed ---
  if (is.null(attempt)) {
    next
  }
  # Perform analyses
  dm <- dist.hamming(data)
  treeNJ<- NJ(dm)
  treeUNJ <- UNJ(dm)
  mm_start <- treeNJ
  # Applying the pratchet method for maximum parsimony
  # Default, fitch + SPR
  mm_tree <- pratchet(data, start = mm_start, minit = 10, maxit = 10000, all = TRUE, trace = 0, method = "fitch", rearrangements = "SPR", perturbation = "ratchet")
  ## Maximum likelihood
  fit_mk <- pml(treeNJ, data = data)
  fit_opt <- optim.pml(
    fit_mk, 
    optNni = TRUE,      # Optimize topology via NNI
    optEdge = TRUE,     # Optimize branch lengths
    #optGamma = TRUE,    # Fit +G (Gamma rate variation across site variants)
    control = pml.control(trace = 0)
  )
  # And now bayesian FBD-based analysis
  BI = fbd(data,
           dates_vector,
           nj_init = FALSE,
           template_file =
             #"beast_templates/BDSKY_serial.xml",
             #"beast_templates/FBD_NJinit_serial.xml",
             "beast_templates/FBD_uncorrLogNorm.xml",
           out = 
             paste("rbeast_out/", "sequences_", i, sep=""),
           chain_length=10000000, 
           bin_folder = beast_bin_folder)
  
  ## Now score everything
  preds <- list(NJ       = treeNJ,
                UNJ      = treeUNJ,
                MP_SC    = ape::consensus(mm_tree, p = 1),
                #MP_mean     = mm_tree,
                ML        = fit_opt$tree,
                FBD_MCC   = BI$mcc_tree#,
                #FBD_MRC   = BI$mrc_tree
  )
  # And now results
  results <- rbind(results, score_methods(preds, gt, tradition = i))
  
  if(!is.null(BI)){
    # save objects to disk
    write.tree(BI$mrc_tree, file=paste("rbeast_out/mrc_", i, ".tree", sep=""))
    write.tree(BI$mcc_tree, file=paste("rbeast_out/mcc_", i, ".tree", sep=""))
  }
  # save objects to disk
  write.tree(fit_opt$tree, file=paste("ml_out/", i, ".tree", sep=""))
  
}
```

```{r plotQuartet_pestimate}

```


```{r plotGRF_pestimate}
plot_metric_boxplots(results, "cid", ylab = "gRF  dissimilarity", title = "Unrooted point estimate trees gRF distance to GT", subtitle = "(Topology)", methods = default_methods)
```

```{r summary_pestimate}

```

```{r reso_pestimate}

```

# Benchmark bootstrapped methods

```{r phyloFunc}
nj_fun <- function(x) {
    dm <- dist.hamming(x)
    NJ(dm)
  }
unj_fun <- function(x) {
    dm <- dist.hamming(x)
    UNJ(dm)
}
mp_fun <- function(x) {
  mm_start <- NJ(dist.hamming(x))
  trees = pratchet(x, start = mm_start, minit = 10, maxit = 10000, all = TRUE, trace = 0, method = "fitch", rearrangements = "SPR", perturbation = "ratchet")
  if (inherits(trees, "multiPhylo")) {
    trees <- ape::consensus(trees, p = 1)
  }
  trees
}
```

```{r benchmark_bs, echo=FALSE}
set.seed(123)
results_bs = NULL
n = 99
#n = 5
pb = txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = n, style = 3)
for(i in 0:n){
  attempt <- tryCatch({
    # Load data and gt tree
    ## load, clean, write, read each nexus file
    ### Data first
    raw <- readLines(paste("simulations_data/simulated_traditions_22_07/sequences_", i, ".nex", sep = ""), warn = FALSE)
    # create the dates vector for bayesian methods
    matches <- regmatches(raw, regexec("ms_([0-9]+)\\|([0-9]+)", raw))
    matched_matrix <- do.call(rbind, lapply(matches, function(x) if(length(x) == 3) x[2:3] else NULL))
    # Create a lookup vector: c("305" = 246, "108" = 120, ...)
    dates_vector <- setNames(as.numeric(matched_matrix[,2]), matched_matrix[,1])
    # and now clean the names to avoid issues with nexus reading
    clean_raw <- gsub("ms\\_|[|]\\S*", "", raw)
    tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".nex")
    writeLines(clean_raw, tmp)
    data <- ape::read.nexus.data(tmp)
    unlink(tmp)
    data = phyDat(data, type = "USER", levels = 0:10, ambiguity=NA)
    ### Then GT, without forgetting the 0-length edge conversion
    gt_raw = readLines(con = paste("simulations_data/simulated_traditions_22_07/tree_", i, ".newick", sep = ""), warn = FALSE)
    gt <- convert_gt_internal_nodes(gt_raw)
  }, error = function(e) {
    # Print a warning showing which file failed
    message(sprintf("Skipping iteration %d due to error: %s", i, e$message))
    return(NULL)
  })
  
  # --- 2. Skip to next iteration if loading failed ---
  if (is.null(attempt)) {
    next
  }
  # Perform BS analyses
  ### DISTANCE BASED
  nj_bootstraps <- bootstrap.phyDat(data, FUN = nj_fun, bs = 100)
  treeNJ = ape::consensus(nj_bootstraps, p = 0.5)
  unj_bootstraps <- bootstrap.phyDat(data, FUN = unj_fun, bs = 100)
  treeUNJ <- ape::consensus(unj_bootstraps, p = 0.5)
  
  ### Maximum parsimony
  bs_trees <- bootstrap.phyDat(data, FUN = mp_fun, bs = 100)
  mm_tree <- ape::consensus(bs_trees, p = 0.5)
  
  ## Maximum likelihood
  fit_mk <- pml(NJ(dist.hamming(data)), data = data)
  fit_opt_NNI <- optim.pml(
    fit_mk, 
    optNni = TRUE,
    optEdge = TRUE,
    control = pml.control(trace = 0)
  )
  bs_trees_nni <- bootstrap.pml(
    fit_opt_NNI, 
    bs = 100, 
    multicore = TRUE,
    optNni = TRUE
  )
  fit_opt_NNIBS = ape::consensus(bs_trees_nni, p = 0.5)
  ## And load FBD MRC
  mrc_file <- paste0("rbeast_out/mrc_", i, ".tree")
  fbd_mrc  <- if (file.exists(mrc_file)) ape::read.tree(mrc_file) else NULL
  ## Now score everything
  preds <- list(NJ_BS       = treeNJ,
                UNJ_BS      = treeUNJ,
                MP_BS       = mm_tree,
                ML_BS       = fit_opt_NNIBS,
                FBD_MRC     = fbd_mrc
  )
  results_bs <- rbind(results_bs, score_methods(preds, gt, tradition = i))
}
```
